tasks.short: Check and file employee documents in AFAS, including contracts, training records, leave forms and sensitive HR correspondence.

today.trigger: An employee, manager, recruiter or training colleague sends a document or changes an existing record.
steps: Collect the document from Outlook, Teams, SharePoint or the relevant system.
Check the employee, dates, signatures and required information.
Compare the document with the AFAS record and applicable template or policy.
Ask the sender to correct gaps or inconsistencies.
File the final document and update its status.
drudgery: Renaming attachments and identifying the right employee
Checking the same fields across documents
today.time_sinks: Finding the latest version, resolving inconsistent dates and deciding where sensitive documents belong.

lenses.faster: Extract employee identifiers, dates and document types automatically, then check completeness against approved rules. Repeated reading, renaming and filing largely disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A new document starts classification, duplicate checks and a proposed filing action. Routine items follow approved rules; grievances and disputed performance records enter a review queue.
lenses.ambitious: Check every new file for missing evidence and expiry dates before these cause onboarding delays or compliance gaps. Extend certificate checks to agency workers where Noordhaven has a legitimate responsibility.
lenses.joy: Remove attachment sorting and repeated signature chasing. Keep the work of resolving difficult cases and helping employees get records corrected.
lenses.options: Show possible document categories and explain any conflicting dates or identities. Offer correction requests suited to the specific missing information.
lenses.altitude: The administrator owns document standards, access rules and exception quality instead of filing each attachment.
reach: Prepare certificate completeness checks for Learning and Development
Maintain contract-template change requests for HR Business Partners
Prepare personnel-file completeness reports for the HRIS Analyst

tasks.human_edge: Recognising when a document is disputed, unusually sensitive or misleading, and handling the employee with care.
tasks.pattern_why: Documents require extraction and classification, but identity checks, required fields, permissions and filing rules can be deterministic. Sensitive exceptions need a human gate.

in_practice.trigger: A document arrives through an approved intake channel or connected system.
steps: Check sender access, scan the attachment and match it to an employee using reliable identifiers.
Extract document type, dates and missing fields with source references.
Apply deterministic completeness, duplicate, retention and permission checks.
Present the proposed filing location and record changes for approval.
File the approved version and route unresolved issues to the responsible HR colleague.
in_practice.human_gate: The administrator approves filing and changes during initial deployment; sensitive or disputed documents always require review. Managers' verzuim files must exclude medical diagnoses and treatment details.
systems: Recruitee and Studytube where access is available
data_needed: Employee identifiers and current employment records
Document categories and required-field rules
Approved templates and CAO versions
Access and retention rules by document category
Authorised source documents
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted HR processing log records source references, extracted fields, checks, approval and destination without copying sensitive document text into general logs.

evidence.claim: Microsoft AI Builder supports document data extraction that can feed Power Automate workflows.
evidence.source: Microsoft AI Builder document processing and Power Automate

evidence.claim: Document extraction plus deterministic checks could reduce Noordhaven's manual filing work; the estimate is untested.

risks: A wrong employee match could expose a confidential document.
An extraction error could turn a disputed statement into an apparent fact.
Employer absence records could accidentally include medical information.
Document copies could remain beyond the applicable AVG/GDPR retention period.
research_questions: Which document categories account for most handling time, and how many arrive through structured channels already?
Can the available AFAS connectors file documents with the required permissions and audit trail?
What accuracy does extraction achieve on Dutch contracts, handwritten forms and agency documents?
Which proposed changes require OR consent under the applicable personnel-data arrangements?

tasks.short: Keep employee details, approved pay data, absences and employment dates correct in AFAS.

today.trigger: An employee submits a change, an approved payroll input arrives or a manager reports an employment update.
steps: Collect the change and identify its authorised source.
Compare it with the current AFAS record.
Check required fields, effective dates and approval.
Enter or import the update and resolve validation errors.
Confirm completion and retain the supporting evidence.
drudgery: Checking employee numbers and date formats
Reconciling repeated versions of the same change
today.time_sinks: Resolving inconsistent sources and correcting changes entered against the wrong date or employee.

lenses.faster: Use validated forms and approved system feeds to update AFAS directly. Copying fields and checking formatting disappear.
lenses.autonomous: Approved changes trigger validation and posting automatically. Conflicting dates, unexpected pay changes and unmatched employees stop in an exception queue.
lenses.ambitious: Check record quality daily across all sites, including gaps that later disrupt payroll or onboarding. Give employees clear confirmation of completed changes.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive data entry and avoidable correction work. Keep investigation of the exceptions that need context.
lenses.options: For a conflict, show the current value, incoming value and supporting source side by side. Offer correction or referral routes without inventing missing information.
lenses.altitude: The administrator manages data quality rules, reliable sources and exception resolution.
reach: Validate payroll inputs for the Payroll Specialist
Maintain employee-data quality reports for the HRIS Analyst
Resolve agency-worker identifier mismatches with site administration

tasks.human_edge: Determining which source is authoritative when records conflict and spotting changes that may harm an employee.
tasks.pattern_why: Structured updates have explicit validation rules and checkable results. A model is unnecessary for routine posting; AI coding can help build the integration.

in_practice.trigger: A validated employee form or authorised source system submits a change.
steps: Match the employee and check source authority and field-level permissions.
Validate values, effective dates, duplicates and payroll cutoffs.
Post permitted routine changes using an authorised AFAS connector.
Read back the record and reconcile it with the intended update.
Confirm success or send a specific exception to the administrator.
in_practice.human_gate: Routine authorised updates run automatically. Pay changes, bank-detail changes and termination reasons require the designated approval and identity checks before posting.
systems: AFAS Profit GetConnector and UpdateConnector where supported
data_needed: Employee identifiers and current field values
Field-level source and approval rules
Effective-date rules and payroll cutoff calendar
Approved change requests
Permitted absence fields without medical details
in_practice.logs_to: The restricted AFAS integration log records request ID, authorised source, changed fields, approvals and read-back result; sensitive values are masked where possible.

evidence.claim: AFAS provides GetConnector and UpdateConnector mechanisms for reading and updating supported records.
Structured input validation and reconciliation can automate most routine record updates, subject to Noordhaven's connector coverage.

risks: An incorrect effective date could change payroll results.
Retries could duplicate updates unless requests have unique identifiers.
Unauthorised bank-detail changes could enable fraud.
Performance or production data could become employee monitoring requiring a separate legal and OR assessment.
research_questions: What share of updates already arrives in structured, approved form?
Which AFAS fields support safe updates and effective-dated changes through available connectors?
Can read-back reconciliation detect partial failures before payroll closes?
Which fields need independent approval rather than administrator authority?

tasks.short: Process approved hires, transfers, promotions, leave and departures in AFAS with the right dates and supporting records.

today.trigger: HR or a manager approves an employment event with an effective date.
steps: Check the approval and supporting paperwork.
Determine the required changes to position, site, hours, contract or employment status.
Check the applicable CAO and payroll timing.
Update AFAS and prepare required letters or amendments.
Notify payroll and other owners of the approved change.
Check that the event and documents agree.
drudgery: Entering the same effective date in several places
today.time_sinks: Working out event dependencies and correcting mismatches between approval, contract and payroll records.

lenses.faster: Turn an approved event into a complete change package with linked checks and standard documents. Repeated checklist work and copying dates disappear.
lenses.autonomous: Approval of an employment event starts preparation, validation and routing. Posting happens after the designated person approves the package.
lenses.ambitious: Track every event through its payroll and onboarding consequences so fewer changes become late corrections. Report recurring causes of delays across the three sites.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated form completion and handoff chasing. Keep the cases where an employee's circumstances require a careful solution.
lenses.options: Show the consequences of permitted effective dates and contract arrangements. Flag CAO constraints rather than proposing arrangements outside them.
lenses.altitude: The administrator designs employment-event workflows and checks that each event completes correctly.
reach: Prepare payroll-impact summaries for the Payroll Specialist
Prepare standard contract amendments for HR Business Partners
Track access and equipment handoffs with IT and site managers

tasks.human_edge: Checking that the approved change reflects the actual agreement and recognising cases requiring legal or employee-relations advice.
tasks.pattern_why: An employment event spans records, documents and handoffs. Most steps follow rules, but a person must approve contractual and payroll consequences before execution.

in_practice.trigger: An authorised employment-event request reaches the approved workflow.
steps: Retrieve the current AFAS record, event approval and applicable template.
Apply an event-specific checklist with CAO, date and payroll checks.
Prepare a before-and-after record summary and any standard amendment.
Obtain approval from the designated HR or payroll owner.
Post the approved changes and create necessary handoff tasks.
Reconcile records, documents and task completion.
in_practice.human_gate: The authorised owner approves each event package before contractual, pay or employment-status changes take effect; disputed departures go to the HR Business Partner.
data_needed: Approved event type and effective date
Current employment terms and site assignment
Applicable transport or warehouse CAO rules
Approved templates and signing authority
Payroll calendar and downstream task owners
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted event register links the approval, before-and-after values, document version, AFAS result and downstream completion status.

evidence.claim: Power Automate supports approval workflows and actions across connected services.
AFAS connectors support the record integration component where the relevant update objects are available.
A complete CAO-aware employment-event workflow for Noordhaven would need configuration and testing.

risks: Using the wrong CAO or template could create an incorrect amendment.
A partial workflow failure could leave payroll and HR records inconsistent.
Leave processing could incorrectly alter statutory or contractual entitlements.
An automated departure workflow could act before the employment decision is final.
research_questions: Which event types are frequent and sufficiently standard for a fixed workflow?
Are both CAOs and signing authorities available as maintained rules?
Can AFAS updates be reconciled and safely recovered after partial failure?
How much elapsed time comes from approval waiting rather than administrator handling?

tasks.short: Check applications in Recruitee for stated job requirements and prepare questions for the recruiter.

today.trigger: A candidate applies for a warehouse, transport or office vacancy.
steps: Read the application and vacancy requirements.
Locate evidence of required experience, availability and certificates.
Mark missing or unclear information.
Ask the candidate or recruiter for clarification.
Record factual notes and pass the application to the recruiter.
today.time_sinks: Interpreting unclear applications and distinguishing absent evidence from a candidate actually lacking a requirement.

lenses.faster: Prepare a source-linked summary of stated qualifications and missing information. The administrator checks the summary instead of repeatedly searching the CV.
lenses.autonomous: New applications can trigger factual extraction and a draft clarification request. A person decides eligibility and any pipeline movement that affects selection.
lenses.ambitious: Give every applicant a consistent completeness check and quicker clarification, including people with unconventional CVs. Assess whether this improves time to hire and productive 90-day hires.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive reading and note copying. Keep the conversations that help candidates explain relevant experience.
lenses.options: Offer several neutral clarification questions and show alternative evidence for a requirement. Do not generate candidate rankings or infer suitability from personal characteristics.
lenses.altitude: The administrator maintains clear evidence requirements and checks that application handling is consistent.
reach: Prepare factual recruiter briefings
Check vacancy requirements for ambiguous certificate wording
Monitor application-completeness delays for the HRIS Analyst

tasks.human_edge: Understanding transferable experience, avoiding unfair assumptions and explaining missing requirements respectfully.
tasks.pattern_why: Extracting facts can help, but assessing an applicant's qualifications affects employment opportunity. The administrator and recruiter remain responsible for interpretation and selection.

in_practice.trigger: The administrator opens a new application in Recruitee.
steps: Retrieve the application and approved vacancy requirements.
Extract only relevant stated facts with links to the supporting text.
Label each requirement as evidenced, unclear or not mentioned without making an eligibility decision.
Draft neutral questions about missing evidence.
Have the administrator verify the notes and the recruiter decide the next stage.
in_practice.human_gate: A person verifies the summary before using it and approves every selection-related action. Assess EU AI Act recruitment classification, AVG/GDPR requirements and applicable OR involvement before deployment; human review alone does not remove high-risk obligations.
data_needed: Candidate-provided application material
Job-relevant requirements and acceptable evidence
Recruitment privacy and retention rules
Permitted qualification-check instructions
Source-linked extraction output
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted Recruitee notes retain verified facts, sources and the human decision; avoid retaining unnecessary generated interpretations or sensitive traits.

evidence.claim: Recruitee provides candidate records and recruitment pipeline stages.
Language models can draft source-linked qualification summaries, but accuracy and fairness require testing on Noordhaven's applications.

risks: The summary could invent qualifications or overlook relevant experience.
Proxy features such as names, age or address could introduce discrimination.
Missing information could be mistaken for failed eligibility.
The intended use could fall within EU AI Act high-risk recruitment requirements.
Overreliance on the summary could make human review ineffective.
research_questions: Does the proposed intended use fall within EU AI Act high-risk recruitment rules, and can the chosen provider meet the relevant obligations?
How often do summaries miss evidence in Dutch, multilingual or unconventional applications?
Can every extracted fact be traced directly to candidate-provided evidence?
Does a pilot improve handling time without changing rejection rates unfairly across applicant groups?

tasks.short: Answer employee and applicant questions about pay, benefits, eligibility, training and HR procedures.

today.trigger: An employee or applicant contacts HR through Outlook, Teams or a site manager.
steps: Identify the question and whether it concerns personal information.
Look up the applicable policy, CAO or authorised employee record.
Check exceptions or ask payroll, recruitment or Learning and Development.
Explain the answer and required next steps.
Record or route any follow-up action.
drudgery: Redirecting questions to the right colleague
today.time_sinks: Determining which CAO applies and distinguishing a routine question from a personal entitlement dispute.

lenses.faster: Retrieve an answer from approved, current sources with the relevant clause attached. Repeated searching and rewriting disappear for routine questions.
lenses.autonomous: An authenticated question triggers a bounded answer or a routed case. Unclear entitlement, disputed pay and absence cases go to the responsible person.
lenses.ambitious: Provide clear HR answers outside office hours for shift workers at all three sites. Use unresolved questions to improve policies and onboarding instructions.
lenses.joy: Reduce the repeated FAQ workload. Keep personal conversations where reassurance, judgement or a sensitive explanation matters.
lenses.options: Offer a short answer, a plain-language explanation or the source clause. For policy choices, explain the available routes without deciding a disputed entitlement.
lenses.altitude: The administrator owns the quality, coverage and escalation rules of the HR information service.
reach: Maintain first-line benefits information for Compensation and Benefits
Answer routine training-access questions for Learning and Development
Publish recurring payroll explanations approved by the Payroll Specialist

tasks.human_edge: Recognising worry or conflict behind a simple question and explaining sensitive decisions in a way the employee can trust.
tasks.pattern_why: A model can phrase answers from retrieved policy text. Authentication, source selection, CAO applicability and escalation must be governed by explicit rules.

in_practice.trigger: An employee or applicant submits a question through the approved HR channel.
steps: Authenticate the requester where personal information is involved and determine the permitted scope.
Retrieve current approved sources using site, worker type and applicable CAO.
Draft an answer with source references and a clear next step.
Release only answers within the approved routine-question scope; route uncertainty or disputes to HR.
Record the outcome and send unanswered topics to the knowledge owner.
in_practice.human_gate: Approved routine answers can be sent automatically. Personal pay disputes, contract interpretation, grievances and Wet verbetering poortwachter case advice require the appropriate HR or payroll owner.
systems: Microsoft Teams or another approved HR access channel
AFAS Profit read access for explicitly permitted personal queries
data_needed: Current CAOs and company policies with owners and effective dates
Approved FAQs and escalation rules
Requester identity and access rights
Applicable employment category
Minimal authorised personal record fields where necessary
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted HR service log records topic, source versions, answer status and escalation; conversation retention follows the relevant privacy rules.

evidence.claim: Microsoft Copilot Studio supports knowledge-based agents and configured actions.
A bounded HR question service could handle routine policy questions; Dutch CAO accuracy and shift-worker access need validation.

risks: A stale or incorrectly selected CAO clause could produce a wrong answer.
Personal salary or benefits information could reach the wrong requester.
A fluent answer could conceal missing evidence or a policy conflict.
Warehouse and agency workers may lack practical access to Teams.
Employees could share medical information in a general HR chat.
research_questions: What proportion of current questions has a clear answer in maintained, approved sources?
Can retrieval enforce permissions and choose the correct CAO version reliably?
Which channel can shift workers and agency workers actually access?
Can a pilot consistently escalate ambiguous entitlement and sensitive absence questions?

tasks.short: Turn an approved hiring decision into a signed contract, AFAS record and complete onboarding handoff.

today.trigger: The recruiter and authorised manager confirm the candidate and agreed employment terms.
steps: Collect approved terms and the candidate's required information.
Check identity and work-authorisation evidence through the authorised process.
Prepare the contract using the correct CAO and template.
Obtain internal approval and signatures.
Create the employee record and hand off payroll information.
Arrange onboarding tasks, training and site preparation.
today.time_sinks: Resolving missing approvals, unusual contract terms and dependencies before the employee's first shift.

lenses.faster: Populate a checked hiring package from approved Recruitee terms and verified candidate information. Repeated data entry, contract assembly and task creation disappear.
lenses.autonomous: An approved hiring decision starts the paperwork workflow and reminders. Contract release and activation follow human approval and required verification.
lenses.ambitious: Give every new hire a complete first-week plan and track day-30, day-60 and day-90 follow-ups. Connect administrative readiness to productive hires who stay for 90 days.
lenses.joy: Remove copying and routine chasing. Keep welcoming new colleagues and resolving the obstacles that could spoil their start.
lenses.options: Show feasible start dates and onboarding schedules based on shift, trainer and certificate availability. Flag the costs and dependencies of each option.
lenses.altitude: The administrator owns hiring readiness and the handoff from accepted offer to a prepared first shift.
reach: Coordinate first-week onboarding for recruiters and site managers
Prepare required training enrolments for Learning and Development
Track new-hire check-in completion for HR Business Partners

tasks.human_edge: Confirming that agreed terms are understood, verifying sensitive evidence and making a new employee feel expected.
tasks.pattern_why: The paperwork crosses recruitment, HR records, contracts and training. Software can orchestrate the steps, while hiring authority, contractual approval and identity checks stay with people.

in_practice.trigger: Recruitee records an authorised hiring decision with approved terms.
steps: Retrieve approved terms and request only the missing information through a secure channel.
Validate completeness, CAO selection and required human verification status.
Generate the contract and onboarding package from controlled templates.
Obtain authorised contract approval and signatures.
Create or activate the AFAS record and route payroll, IT and site tasks.
Track first-week readiness and schedule agreed day-30 to day-90 follow-ups.
in_practice.human_gate: The authorised manager makes the hiring decision; designated staff verify identity and work authorisation, approve terms and release the contract. Mandatory safety clearance must be confirmed before relevant work starts.
data_needed: Approved offer terms and hiring authority
Verified candidate details and required verification status
Applicable CAO, contract type and current template
Site, shift, start date and manager
Role-specific training and certificate requirements
Onboarding owners and follow-up schedule
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted hiring-case register links approvals, template version, signature status, AFAS employee ID and onboarding task outcomes without duplicating identity documents.

evidence.claim: Recruitee offers an API for integration with recruitment data.
Power Automate supports approval and task orchestration, while AFAS connectors can handle supported record updates.
evidence.source: Microsoft Power Automate and AFAS Profit connectors

evidence.claim: The complete hiring-to-onboarding workflow and its effect on 90-day outcomes are proposed for Noordhaven.

risks: Incorrect terms or the wrong CAO could enter a contract.
Candidate and employee records could be matched incorrectly.
Identity documents could be unnecessarily copied into multiple systems.
Training enrolment could be mistaken for completed certification.
Automatic task completion could hide an unprepared site or first shift.
research_questions: Are approved offer terms captured consistently enough to generate contracts?
Which onboarding delays actually contribute to poor first-week completion or early departures?
Can the available integrations transfer data without duplicating sensitive identity evidence?
Who confirms that a hire is ready for the first shift, including mandatory certificates?

tasks.short: Find verified facts in employee files for authorised HR questions and personnel changes.

today.trigger: A manager, HR colleague or payroll colleague asks for information needed for an employee action.
steps: Check the purpose of the request and the requester's access.
Search AFAS and relevant documents.
Compare dates, versions and conflicting information.
Prepare a factual answer with supporting records.
Send it securely or refer the case to the responsible HR colleague.
drudgery: Searching several folders for one fact
today.time_sinks: Finding the authoritative record and ensuring that the requester receives only information they are entitled to see.

lenses.faster: Retrieve a permission-filtered fact pack with dates and source links. Repeated searches and manual timeline assembly disappear.
lenses.autonomous: An authorised routine request triggers retrieval and consistency checks. Restricted, conflicting or disputed material goes to the administrator.
lenses.ambitious: Make routine personnel actions consistently evidence-based and show where records are missing before decisions are made. Track recurring information gaps by process.
lenses.joy: Remove file hunting and copying. Keep investigation of contradictions and thoughtful handling of sensitive requests.
lenses.options: Offer a short answer, a dated timeline or a source table according to the request. Show competing records explicitly when the facts disagree.
lenses.altitude: The administrator manages evidence quality and access boundaries for HR information requests.
reach: Prepare factual case packs for HR Business Partners
Prepare payroll discrepancy evidence for the Payroll Specialist
Maintain source-quality checks for the HRIS Analyst

tasks.human_edge: Understanding why a fact is requested, distinguishing evidence from interpretation and refusing inappropriate disclosure.
tasks.pattern_why: Structured queries should retrieve known fields directly; a model can summarise permitted documents with citations. Access control and evidence checks must sit outside the model.

in_practice.trigger: An authenticated requester submits a supported HR information request.
steps: Validate the purpose, employee identity and requester permissions.
Query permitted AFAS fields and retrieve only relevant authorised documents.
Build a source-linked fact pack and check dates and contradictions.
Release routine factual answers within the approved disclosure rules.
Route disputed facts, restricted material or action recommendations to the responsible HR colleague.
in_practice.human_gate: Routine factual answers can run automatically within established access rules. Grievance, performance, termination and sensitive absence case packs require review before disclosure or use.
data_needed: Requester role and purpose
Employee identifier
Field and document access permissions
Authoritative-source hierarchy and version dates
Approved request types and disclosure rules
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted access log records requester, purpose, queried sources, released fields and review outcome without reproducing the whole personnel file.

evidence.claim: AFAS GetConnectors can provide structured records for authorised queries.
SharePoint supports permission-controlled document storage and version history.
A source-linked fact pack combining these systems is feasible but requires testing of access boundaries and factual accuracy.

risks: Search indexing could expose documents beyond the requester's permissions.
A summary could merge contradictory versions into a false statement.
A factual answer could be treated as an employment recommendation.
Broad access logs could themselves become a second sensitive personnel database.
research_questions: Which requests can be answered entirely from authoritative structured AFAS fields?
Can document retrieval enforce the same permissions as the source systems at query time?
How often do employee files contain conflicting dates or unsigned versions?
Can reviewers verify every material fact from its cited source without opening the entire file?

tasks.short: Collect missing employee records from managers, employees, training colleagues and staffing agencies.

today.trigger: A personnel file, onboarding case, training requirement or approved employment event lacks required evidence.
steps: Identify the missing record and its responsible owner.
Send a request explaining what is needed and by when.
Track responses in email or a spreadsheet.
Remind the owner and escalate overdue requests.
Check received evidence and attach it to the correct case.
drudgery: Following up across shifts and agency contacts
today.time_sinks: Waiting for the right person, resolving vague requests and receiving incomplete or misidentified documents.

lenses.faster: Create precise requests from a missing-record checklist and track replies against the case automatically. Manual chase lists and repeated status checks disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A missing required record triggers a secure request, timed reminders and escalation. Completion is recorded only when the evidence passes the relevant checks.
lenses.ambitious: Find missing onboarding and safety evidence before the first shift, across all sites and agencies. Give each owner a clear view of what remains outstanding.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive chasing and inbox checking. Keep the personal follow-up that helps someone overcome a real obstacle.
lenses.options: Offer a permitted alternative evidence route, an adjusted deadline or referral to the correct owner. Keep safety and statutory requirements fixed.
lenses.altitude: The administrator manages evidence-collection rules and removes the recurring causes of missing records.
reach: Coordinate certificate-evidence collection for Learning and Development
Track agency onboarding completeness for site managers
Prepare missing-record trend reports for the HRIS Analyst

tasks.human_edge: Knowing when a delay needs help rather than another reminder and negotiating responsibility across managers and agencies.
tasks.pattern_why: Required-record lists, owners, deadlines, reminder limits and completion checks can be written as rules. A model is optional for extracting facts from an incoming attachment.

in_practice.trigger: A checklist detects a missing required record for an active HR case.
steps: Identify the required evidence, responsible owner and deadline.
Check connected systems first to avoid requesting evidence already held.
Send a specific request through an approved secure channel.
Track receipt and issue limited reminders suited to shifts and agency response windows.
Validate the received evidence and update the case status.
Escalate unresolved, sensitive or safety-critical gaps to the named human owner.
in_practice.human_gate: Routine requests and reminders run automatically. People resolve disputed ownership and statutory or safety exceptions; no reminder workflow may waive a mandatory requirement.
systems: Staffing agency portals through available approved interfaces
data_needed: Required evidence by role and employment event
Case and employee identifiers
Named owners and authorised agency contacts
Deadlines, shift patterns and reminder limits
Secure submission routes and access rules
Existing record status in source systems
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted collection register records requirement, owner, requests, receipt status, validation and escalation; attachments remain in their authorised destination.

evidence.claim: Power Automate supports scheduled workflows, notifications and approval routing.
A rules-based missing-record tracker can reduce chasing, although waiting for external owners will limit elapsed-time gains.

risks: Repeated reminders could reach the wrong person or become excessive.
An agency portal may lack a supported integration.
An uploaded document could be marked complete without validating its content or expiry.
Requests could collect more personal information than Noordhaven needs.
A missing safety certificate could be overlooked if escalation has no accountable owner.
research_questions: Which missing records create the most delay, and who actually owns each one?
Can each staffing agency provide supported status feeds or secure submission routes?
How much time is active chasing compared with waiting for responses?
Which evidence checks can be automated without mistaking receipt for validity?

role.altitude: The HR Administrator becomes the owner of reliable HR records and administrative workflows: setting rules, checking exceptions and ensuring hires and employment changes complete correctly across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo.
reach: Prepare validated payroll inputs and discrepancy evidence for the Payroll Specialist
Coordinate onboarding readiness and first-week task completion for recruiters and site managers
Maintain certificate-evidence completeness with Learning and Development
Prepare factual employment-event and case packs for HR Business Partners
Maintain first-line policy information approved by Compensation and Benefits and payroll
Own record-quality checks and process-delay reporting with the People Analytics and HRIS Analyst
Reconcile approved agency-worker identity and onboarding records with site administration
role.ceiling_note: These eight tasks cover about 45.5% of the role. The task-level handling-time estimates imply roughly 433 hours released per FTE annually, or 865 hours across two FTE, worth about EUR 41,500 at EUR 48/hour as capacity rather than cash savings. Validate that task hours do not overlap before adding them. time_saved_pct estimates administrator handling time; speedup estimates elapsed time from trigger to completed result, including approvals and external waiting. Neither is a measured result. Setup, maintenance and exception work reduce net savings; hiring decisions, disputed entitlements, sensitive cases and required verification still need people.
skills_to_grow: Designing AFAS workflows, connector checks and safe exception handling
Maintaining applicable CAO rules, effective dates and controlled templates
Applying AVG/GDPR data minimisation, permissions and retention rules
Recognising Wet verbetering poortwachter administrative deadlines and employer limits on medical information
Assessing EU AI Act intended use with legal and HR leadership, especially in recruitment
Working with the OR on changes to personnel-data arrangements and monitoring where consent is required
Testing extraction accuracy, source citations and effective human review
Measuring workflow quality, first-week readiness and 90-day hiring outcomes
role.ambitious_version: Run an HR administration service that gives every hire a verified contract, correct payroll setup, required safety evidence and a prepared first week. Use released capacity to fix recurring handoff failures, provide accessible answers for shift workers and support timely 30-, 60- and 90-day follow-ups. Judge progress by fewer corrections and incomplete starts, faster resolution, manager satisfaction and a higher share of hires who become productive and remain after 90 days.
